caption: Juan Sánchez Cotán. Still Life with Quince, Cabbage, Melon, and Cucumber (c. 1602)
alt: A still-life painting of a quince and a cabbage hanging on strings in a stone window frame against a black background, with a cut melon, a slice of it and a cucumber on the ledge below.
bibliography: Sánchez Cotán, Juan. Still Life with Quince, Cabbage, Melon, and Cucumber. c. 1602, San Diego Museum of Art.
